title: Three gravity emitters on the sports model craft

tellings.quote: Years before Ning Li's work ever became public, Lazar described [music] three cylindrical emitters at the base of a craft.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells a claim by Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft in 1988 and 1989 at S4, a secret site in the Nevada desert. Michels says Lazar described three cylinder-shaped "emitters" at the base of one craft, nicknamed the sports model, and that he did so years before the gravity research of a scientist named Ning Li became public. Michels tells it because, if true, Lazar's account would seem to have predicted later science.
